title: What Lane gives a plugin's start adapter
description: Either a role due in a lane, whose start texts the adapter gives, one for each time the role starts, or each lane of the run, from which the adapter gives the first start of each chain to open now.

role.description: The role whose start is due, by its agent type.

lanes.description: Each lane of the run, by which the plugin finds which of its chains stand open.

run.description: The run: the skill that started it and the words typed after its command.

lane.description: Each start that the lane has made so far, in their order, or the first start of a chain that the plugin opened, not yet made.
